theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Consumer Staples (+1.57%) and Communication Svcs (+1.37%) led the market today, while Energy (-2.38%) and Utilities (-1.32%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.54%, defensives +0.15%, and value/cyclicals -0.33% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.02%, Dow +0.51%, Nasdaq -0.18% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.62%, outperforming large caps. The VIX rose 0.54% to 18.67, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.54% to $4,070.50, crude oil was little changed at $81.85, and bitcoin slipped 1.72% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
